# HammerByte

> HammerByte is a software development company in Nadiad, Gujarat, India. Hire the team for website design, Android and iOS apps, EdTech platforms, e-commerce, healthcare sites, corporate websites, and custom digital products. 70+ projects delivered over 11+ years.

- Custom software development
- Website design and corporate websites
- Data-driven web application development
- Mobile application development for Android and iOS (Flutter, React Native, Java)
- Digital products: games, desktop software, and IoT systems

## Industries
- Education and EdTech (learning platforms, institute apps, university management)
- Healthcare (care providers and health-product sites)
